description:
Levels and content of the running game: streaming levels, level instances, World Partition data layers, map travel and
a search over the cooked asset registry.
Workflow: find_assets (asset_class World) to discover maps -> list_levels / get_current_level -> load_level_instance
(streams a map in at a transform; undo unloads it) -> set_level_visibility / unload_level / set_data_layer.
open_level replaces the whole world and ends all undo history.
name: level

tools.description:
Searches the cooked asset registry for assets (maps, meshes, materials, input actions, ...). Only assets packaged with the build are found. Per-actor packages (__ExternalActors__) are skipped.
Returns: Total matches and the assets {path, package, class}, sorted by path. Fails if folder_path does not start with "/" or the class is unknown.

asset_class.description: Only assets of this class or a subclass, e.g. "World" for maps, "StaticMesh", "InputAction". (Class name or path (a Object))

folder_path.description: Folder to search, e.g. "/Game/Maps"; empty = /Game and every plugin content root.

name.description: Only assets whose name contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. "Sandbox".

tools.name: level.find_assets

returnValue.description: Total matches and the assets {path, package, class}, sorted by path. Fails if folder_path does not start with "/" or the class is unknown.

assets.description: Matches sorted by path, at most `limit`.

package.description: Package path, e.g. "/Game/Maps/Sandbox" (what load_level_instance / open_level take for maps).

path.description: Object path, e.g. "/Game/Maps/Sandbox.Sandbox" (pass it to tools that take an asset).

returnValue.title: LevelToolAssetSearch

tools.description: Returns the package path of the loaded map (the persistent level), e.g. "/Game/Maps/Main".
tools.name: level.get_current_level

tools.description:
Lists the persistent level, streaming levels and level instances (loaded/visible state) and data layer states.
Returns: {persistent, streaming:[{name, package, loaded, visible, should_be_loaded, should_be_visible, instance}], data_layers:{name: state}}.
tools.name: level.list_levels

returnValue.description: {persistent, streaming:[{name, package, loaded, visible, should_be_loaded, should_be_visible, instance}], data_layers:{name: state}}.

data_layers.description: World Partition data layers: short name -> Unloaded / Loaded / Activated (empty without World Partition).

persistent.description: Package of the persistent level, e.g. "/Game/Maps/Main".

streaming.description: Streaming levels and level instances, in the world's order.

instance.description: Loaded by load_level_instance (a dynamic level instance).

package.description: Package path, e.g. "/Game/Maps/Sandbox" (or the instance's unique package).

should_be_loaded.description: Requested state (streaming catches up over the next frames).

returnValue.title: LevelToolLevels

tools.description:
Streams a map in as a level instance at a transform and completes when it is loaded and visible. Undoable (undo unloads it).
Returns: {level:{name, package, loaded, visible, ...}} once visible. Fails if the path is not a map package or the map is not in the build.

blocking.description: Finish now with a full streaming flush (frame hitch) instead of waiting over the next frames.

location.description: Offset of the instance [x,y,z] in cm, e.g. [0,0,-5000]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

map.description: Map package, e.g. "/Game/Maps/Sandbox" (see find_assets with asset_class World).

rotation.description: Rotation [pitch,yaw,roll] of the instance. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

tools.name: level.load_level_instance

instance.description: Loaded by load_level_instance (a dynamic level instance).

package.description: Package path, e.g. "/Game/Maps/Sandbox" (or the instance's unique package).

should_be_loaded.description: Requested state (streaming catches up over the next frames).

tools.description:
Travels to another map. This destroys the current world, its scene graph and all undo history; travel happens next frame (poll session.ping until the new map reports).
Returns: The destination package and a note. Fails without confirm, if the path is not a map package or the map is not in the build.
This cannot be undone: only call it after explicit direction or permission from the user.

confirm.description: Must be true: acknowledges that the world and its history are lost.

tools.name: level.open_level

returnValue.description: The destination package and a note. Fails without confirm, if the path is not a map package or the map is not in the build.

travel_to.description: Map package the game travels to.

returnValue.title: LevelToolTravelInfo

tools.description:
Sets a World Partition data layer to Unloaded, Loaded or Activated. Undoable.
Returns: The layer, its new and previous state. Fails if the world has no data layers (not World Partition) or no layer matches (the known ones are listed).

name.description: Data layer short name from list_levels, e.g. "Night".

tools.name: level.set_data_layer

returnValue.description: The layer, its new and previous state. Fails if the world has no data layers (not World Partition) or no layer matches (the known ones are listed).
returnValue.title: LevelToolDataLayerChange

tools.description:
Shows or hides a streaming level (showing also loads it). Undoable.
Returns: The level package and its requested state. Fails if no streaming level matches (the known ones are listed).

blocking.description: Flush streaming now instead of over the next frames.

level.description: Short name or package from list_levels, e.g. "Sandbox".

visible.description: true to show, false to hide (it stays loaded).

tools.name: level.set_level_visibility

returnValue.description: The level package and its requested state. Fails if no streaming level matches (the known ones are listed).
returnValue.title: LevelToolStateChange

tools.description:
Unloads a streaming level or level instance. Undoable (undo loads it back).
Returns: The level package and its requested state. Fails if no streaming level matches (the known ones are listed).

blocking.description: Flush streaming now instead of over the next frames.

level.description: Short name or package from list_levels, e.g. "Sandbox".

tools.name: level.unload_level

returnValue.description: The level package and its requested state. Fails if no streaming level matches (the known ones are listed).
returnValue.title: LevelToolStateChange
